title: Instant Digital Version of LCG
author: CanAdept7703
selftext:
Been working for a while at a LCG aimed at dads and their teenage boys that connect via a shared passion for basketball. Big niche, i know. But while cut in testing and prototyping i wanted to get better Data for balancing and decided to try some sort of digital prototype. 2hours later BAM:

[https://sebahmah.github.io/RoarLeague-Game/](https://sebahmah.github.io/RoarLeague-Game/)

This is so many ways better than the card version, but at the same time i managed to solve many many conundrums i was stuck with.  How many of the 90 cards are relevant, is skill X broken? , is the new sysnergy feture too much etc. Having also claude run 10,000 tests and putting a grade and imapct on each card and each skill has given me a clear view on what needs more balancing.

Everything starting with me wanting actual art for the cards, but i got the feedback that a 132 cards is too much so i wanted to see how the game feels with 90, ... and it feels fine, guess i should try even lower now? 

Any feedback is more than welcome. I plan to print another 5-6 protoype for actual playtesting, but meanwhile this digital version is a godsend.

More Game info: [https://sebahmah.github.io/RoarLeague/](https://sebahmah.github.io/RoarLeague/)
